description:
The user's live market board. Start here when they ask how the
markets are doing in general: "how are the markets today?", "what's
moving?", "market update", a morning check before the open, or
"open the market dashboard".

One call covers the overview: the user's own symbols on top (their
watchlist, then what they asked about most in the last 30 days), then
major indices (US, India, Türkiye, Indonesia, VIX), crypto,
commodities and FX, each with today's change. Don't also call
market_snapshot for the same overview; add other tools only for what
the board doesn't show (futures, news, sectors). For a single
symbol's price or analysis, use that symbol's own tool instead.

Opens as an interactive dashboard; clicking a row asks for that
market's chart or analysis. Clients without app support can read the
`summary` field.
